content.text: Waking a couple of times a night is really common at 19 months. Tonight, when he wakes, try pausing a minute or two before you go in. If you do go in, keep it boring: low voice, a quick pat, and no lights, feeding or picking him up. That helps him learn to settle on his own, and many toddlers start linking sleep cycles within a week or two. If he's sick or in pain, that's one for a doctor.
